Bash(NODE_ENV=development DATABASE_URL="postgresql://neondb_owner:npg_csIURKah4TN5@ep-soft-salad-aeyhh2aj.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require" psql $DATABASE_URL -c "
-- Check for bidirectional link inconsistencies
SELECT 
    t1.id as tx1_id,
    t1.description as tx1_desc,
    t1.linked_transaction_id as tx1_links_to,
    t2.id as tx2_id,
    t2.description as tx2_desc,
    t2.linked_transaction_id as tx2_links_to,
    CASE 
        WHEN t2.linked_transaction_id = t1.id THEN ''CORRECT''
        ELSE ''BROKEN - t2 links to: '' || COALESCE(t2.linked_transaction_id, ''NULL'')
    END as bidirectional_status
FROM transactions t1
LEFT JOIN transactions t2 ON t1.linked_transaction_id = t2.id
WHERE t1.user_id = ''dev-user-123'' 
    AND t1.linked_transaction_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (t2.linked_transaction_id IS NULL OR t2.linked_transaction_id != t1.id)
LIMIT 10;
")

-- 94bb2f0f should link to b58e5eea (same date), not 452e858b (different date)

WHERE id = ''94bb2f0f-3679-4817-acd2-11c6b33fde0e''

SET linked_transaction_id = NULL

    AND user_id = ''dev-user-123'';
")

-- Check Hushåll category transactions for August 2025
SELECT 
    t.date,
    t.description,
    t.amount,
    t.type,
    t.app_category_id,
    h.name as category_name
FROM transactions t
LEFT JOIN huvudkategorier h ON t.app_category_id = h.id
WHERE t.user_id = ''dev-user-123''
    AND h.name = ''Hushåll''
    AND t.date >= ''2025-07-25''  -- August period starts (payday)
    AND t.date <= ''2025-08-24''  -- August period ends

")

Bash(NODE_ENV=development DATABASE_URL="postgresql://neondb_owner:npg_csIURKah4TN5@ep-soft-salad-aeyhh2aj.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require" psql $DATABASE_URL -c "
-- Sum only Transaction type for Hushåll in August period
SELECT 
    SUM(ABS(amount)) as total_amount,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count
FROM transactions t
LEFT JOIN huvudkategorier h ON t.app_category_id = h.id
WHERE t.user_id = ''dev-user-123''
    AND h.name = ''Hushåll''
    AND t.type = ''Transaction''  -- ONLY Transaction type
    AND t.amount < 0  -- ONLY negative amounts
    AND t.date >= ''2025-07-25''
    AND t.date <= ''2025-08-24'';
")

Bash(NODE_ENV=development DATABASE_URL="postgresql://neondb_owner:npg_csIURKah4TN5@ep-soft-salad-aeyhh2aj.c-2.us-east-2.aws.neon.tech/neondb?sslmode=require" psql $DATABASE_URL -c "
-- Check all categories with Transaction type expenses for August
SELECT 
    h.name as category_name,
    SUM(ABS(t.amount)) as total_amount,
    COUNT(*) as transaction_count
FROM transactions t
LEFT JOIN huvudkategorier h ON t.app_category_id = h.id
WHERE t.user_id = ''dev-user-123''
    AND t.type = ''Transaction''
    AND t.amount < 0
    AND t.date >= ''2025-07-25''
    AND t.date <= ''2025-08-24''
    AND h.name IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY total_amount DESC;
")
